review_notes: I read the whole target file (54 lines). It has two theorems: psu_isSimpleGroup_X₀ and psu_small_four_one. The second has an inner branch and an outer branch. Both branches call a CU43 cardinality lemma, rewrite with hcard, and finish with omega. That is a few lines of routine rewriting, not substantial reasoning duplicated in two proofs. I also read the sibling files CentA6ClPSUSmallU3.lean and CentA6ClPSUSmallU3Bar.lean. They handle a different case (PSU 3 2) with different machinery (descent, dihedral pairs), so they share no nontrivial reasoning with the target. A grep showed that the reusable helpers psu_centralizer_conj_range and psu_card_fixed_eq_card_inf are already factored into CentA6ClPSUSmallBase and are used only in the target. I found no repeated proof block that would justify a shared lemma. I did not search every other file in the repository for a similar PSU skeleton, so a duplicate elsewhere is possible but unsupported by anything I saw.
